title: Megaponera analis, stridulerende kolonne, 2023-05-10 16h16, Skrikfontein, b
author: JMK
changes: Matabele ants (Megaponera analis) stridulating: the chirping hiss of a column of ants marching home from a termite raid, made by rubbing ridged body segments together. Trimmed to 1.00–3.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. No high-pass: the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
